introduction: New Mexico TANF is called NMWorks. Apply through YesNM or ask an Income Support Division office for assistance, then complete the eligibility interview.
description: New Mexico TANF is called NMWorks. Apply through YesNM or ask an Income Support Division office for assistance, then complete the eligibility interview.

sections.who: The state assesses residence, income, resources and dependent children’s circumstances. An 18-year-old child must meet the stated full-time high-school and expected-graduation condition.
sections.get: Approved cash assistance is deposited to EBT for family needs. New Mexico Works also offers qualifying participants employment-related services and paid work-experience opportunities.
sections.docs:
• Household income and requested resource information.
  • Children’s ages and status records requested by the worker.
  • School information for an 18-year-old child.
  • Other evidence on the interview checklist.
sections.apply:
1. Apply for cash assistance

    Use the YesNM application link from the HCA TANF page.

  2. Complete the interview

    Explain household finances and caregiving circumstances. Ask the worker about missing records or accommodation needs.

  3. Review cash and participation instructions

    Read the decision and discuss any assigned New Mexico Works plan.
sections.after: Report changes under the notice instructions. Ask the caseworker how employment income or a participation barrier affects your case before assuming assistance will end.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using HCA TANF eligibility and intake, New Mexico Works employment services. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is NMWorks a separate application from TANF?
The state describes NMWorks as its TANF program name.
The state lists a full-time high-school and graduation-before-19 condition; confirm the child’s circumstances with ISD.
The state says monthly assistance is deposited to an Electronic Benefits Card.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
